bias_targets.methodology: Measuring directional bias amplification (BiasAmp_A->T and BiasAmp_T->A) in image classification/object detection (COCO), facial attribute classification (CelebA), and image captioning using gender as the protected attribute. It also measures gender-occupation associations in masked language modeling (FitBERT) using gendered pronouns.

Calculating bias amplification and False Positive Rate (FPR) disparities across two racial groups in the COMPAS criminal risk prediction dataset to evaluate the metric's limitations in risk prediction settings.
